name: figr-frontend-assignment
description: Figr Viewer: a cross-origin preview board

scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,host "npm run backend" "vite preview --config vite.config.mjs"
scripts.dev: npm run build:agent && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,agent,host "npm run backend" "npm run build:agent -- --watch" "vite --config vite.config.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:agent && vite build --config vite.config.mjs
